managedCronJobs.purpose: Daily re-pricing of the collection's market values; appends one point per day to the value-over-time history. Paid amounts stay as recorded.

Daily audit of the card catalog against the complete Lorcana card universe (LorcanaJSON, Lorcast, DL Promos): inserts newly released or newly sourced printings so every card can be scanned, searched, and added. Existing cards, ownership, and prices are never touched.

Daily Funko market recording: appends today's sold-based value point to each researched Funko figure's value history (eBay sold data) and refreshes its catalog price, so Funko value history accumulates on the same cadence as card re-pricing.
